title: One number, many moduli: the Chinese Remainder Theorem
summary: RSA and many side-channel attacks lean on a simple fact: if you know a secret modulo coprime pieces, there is exactly one answer modulo their product. We recover that unique x by hand on tiny moduli.

case.name: RSA-CRT fault attacks (Boneh–DeMillo–Lipton lineage)
case.impact: A single faulty RSA-CRT signature can leak the factorization of n; hardware glitching and bit flips turned the CRT speedup into a key-recovery oracle
